title: Last in, first out: push and pop both happen at the top
caption: A Python list as a stack: append pushes at the right end and pop() removes from it, both O(1).

frames.text: push 5: the stack was empty, so 5 is both the bottom and the top.
push 1: it goes on top of 5.
push 2: the top is now 2, the most recent push.
pop returns 2, the last value pushed.
pop returns 1. 5 went in first and will come out last.
